docs-context.description: Strategic project context (architecture, rules, business logic, permission system, naming). Read on demand to understand the codebase or domain rules.

docs-protocols.description: Project-specific protocols and templates (e.g. api-endpoint-factory). Read on demand when a task matches a known recipe.

opencode-protocols.description: Agent protocols (prompt-pipeline, agent-installer, broad-investigation-template). Read on demand for convention reference.

delivery.description: Delivery Agent - Sole interface between human and agent system. Translates, writes documentation directly, and delegates ALL technical work to subagents.

orchestrator.description: Orchestrator Agent - Persistent coordinator. Receives handoff from delivery, decomposes tasks, releases subagents, and maintains state across delegations. Works exclusively in English.

coder.description: Programming, bug fixes, feature implementation, refactoring

reviewer.description: Code review, security audit, best practices, performance

tester.description: Unit tests, integration tests, test coverage, e2e

architect.description: System design, architecture, module boundaries, patterns

explorer.description: Codebase exploration, file search, dependency analysis

project-context.description: Project context agent - Reads and writes docs/ on demand. Knows the project structure and canonical documentation.

vision-relay.description: Vision Relay - Cheap image inspection for non-vision models. Receives one image plus one focused question, returns a compact textual answer. Does NOT explore, does NOT chain of thought, does NOT touch files.

external-scout.description: External Scout - Fetches live documentation for external Go libraries on demand. Receives a library path, version, and one focused question, returns a compact textual answer. Read-only plus webfetch.

interpreter.description: Interpreter - Lightweight normalization helper invoked as Step 0 by delivery. Reconciles vocabulary, captures constraints, may ask the user one batch of clarifying questions via the question tool, and returns a compact routing packet.
